The foursquare cube geometry takes Revelation 21:16 at its plain reading: length, breadth, and height equal, so the city is a cube. Its history is the geometry of equal-sided figures, from Euclid's Elements to modern CAD: a cube is fixed by one edge, its surface is six times the square of the edge, and its volume is the cube of the edge. This record gives those formulas and applies them only at declared edges, never at an unsettled edge.

body:
Large-coordinate precision is the study of what floating-point arithmetic does at planetary scale: a 64-bit float has a unit in the last place of about 0.0000002 m at coordinates near 2,220,000 m, but about 0.00003 m near 40,000,000 m, so absolute precision degrades as coordinates grow. This record demonstrates the effect with exact ulp values and states the remedy used by serious modelers: local origins, so model coordinates stay small and precise while a separate transform places the model on the globe.
